proposals.concept: Danielle Reyes and Carla Holloway write a direct, memorable, emotionally honest R&B song about mutual commitment, with a clearly lifting chorus and a late-1980s danceable rhythmic foundation. Sire staff producer Lisa Sterling brings polished arrangement ideas and a contemporary crossover edge without burying Danielle's strong vocal personality. Creative intention only; do not assume any particular song quality, hit or label approval.
